Marta L.: FYI: NorthStar just flagged flaky inference hangs in their marketplace image when running batched quantized evals. They repro locally and on our SI harness. Stack: AMD driver ROCm 5.7 + MIOpen variations + hip-clang. Behavior: intermittent hang after ~30-40 batches, sometimes OOM, sometimes kernel timeout. Looks like a device-resources contention or kernel shim regression. Ravi S.: I reproduced on their image: `northstar/llm-quant:prod-2026-03` with our integration tests. Repro script attached by partner. Devon W.: Can you drop the minimal repro? Harper K.: Partner repro (from NorthStar): ```bash
# run 64 batches of size 16, token_len=512
python tools/run_batched.py --model redwood/llm-quant-8bit --batch 16 --tokens 512 --batches 64
```
Hang/timeout around batch 32-45 consistently. logs: `HIP_ERROR: launch timed out` then process stuck. Devon W.: On our infra, switching to ROCm 5.3 (their older validated baseline) eliminates hangs. We also see slightly different kernel selection on 5.7 for grouped attention kernels. Marta L.: Partner asks if we can either (A) recommend they pin marketplace image to ROCm 5.3 + hipclang 4.8, or (B) accept a hotfix runtime image that forces a different kernel path. They prefer pinning for next-week announcement. Lucy P.: NorthStar timeline: announcement + co-marketing next Wednesday. They want a clear gating matrix by EOD today. Devon W.: Proposed short-term plan: 1) Ask partner to publish a pinned variant `northstar-rocm-pinned-53` built with ROCm 5.3 + MIOpen pinned to 2.5.2 2) Run full SI regression + our eval set (Harper) 3) If green, allow announcement with a note recommending the pinned image for heavy-batch/quant workloads 4) Parallel: eng-runtime to add a kernel-selection override flag (safe-path) for ROCm 5.7 to force older kernel fallback; target hotfix next week. Harper K.: I'll start SI regression on pinned image now (eval suite + perf). ETA 5-6 hours. ops-bot: release created: `northstar-rocm-pinned-53` -> build-20260323. Ravi S.: Partner says they can cut pinned image by 15:00 PT and hold the co-marketing until we validate. Marta L.: I'll reserve the weekend imaging slot in case we need to push replacement images into the marketplace. Devon W.: I'll open a runtime PR to add a `--rocm-safe-fallback` config and a small canary plan (2% of traffic), link will be posted. Devon W.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/889 (draft)

Marta L.: Quick note on comms: If we let them announce with a pinned image, marketing wants one sentence: "Recommended image for heavy quant workloads: northstar-rocm-pinned-53" and a follow-up tech note about the runtime hotfix rollout. Lucy P.: Action items: - Ravi: coordinate partner image cut + confirm announcement hold - Harper: run SI regression + perf smoke against pinned image - Marta: book hotfix window and marketplace replacement plan - Devon: PR for rocm kernel-fallback + canary plan - All: post go/no-go in this thread by 17:00 PT. @Lucy P. if blocked. :eyes: Ravi S.: Partner will cut pinned image by 15:00 PT and will wait for our go/no-go. I'll paste partner CI logs here when available. Harper K.: Starting eval run now. I'll post results (pass/fail + perf delta) in-thread. ops-bot: canary job queued: job-62421. Devon W.: I'll update PR with unit tests and small canary harness. Lucy P.: Keep updates concise; partner execs are watching. :thumbsup:
